name: User-assigned managed identity
summary: Standalone identity that can be attached to multiple resources or federated with an external OIDC issuer, avoiding a client secret for Kubernetes workload identity or GitHub Actions.
useWhen: You need one identity shared across several resources, e.g. a pull identity attached to several container apps
You need federated (secretless) identity for AKS workload identity or a GitHub Actions OIDC login
You need an identity that must exist before the resource that will use it, e.g. a Container App's registry pull identity
avoidWhen: One resource with its own system-assigned identity is enough (simpler, and Azure deletes it with the resource)
